name: Elvis Presley

whyMatters.en: Sun Records heat, television hips, teenage voltage: Elvis turns southern music into a global star industry—rock's first seizure of the front stage.
whyMatters.zh: Sun Records 的热度、电视上的胯、青少年电压：Elvis 把南方音乐焊成全球明星工业——摇滚第一次抢占正面舞台。

note.zh: Sun Records：摇滚明星工业开机
电视时代的身体与丑闻能量

interviewQuotes.text: I don't know anything about music. In my line you don't have to.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Elvis Presley

lyricQuotes: You ain't nothin' but a hound dog

shortBio.en: The switch that makes rock a global mass-culture event.
shortBio.zh: 摇滚成为全球大众文化事件的开关。

body.en:
Elvis is not only a voice. He is the moment southern rhythm, TV close-ups, and teenage want fuse into an industry.

After him, rock does not ask to enter mass culture. It already owns the doorway.
body.zh:
Elvis 不只是嗓子。他是南方节奏、电视特写与少年欲望焊成工业的那一刻。

在他之后，摇滚不必再申请进入大众文化。门口已经是它的。

body.en:
Before Elvis, popular stages still negotiate how much body and Black-rooted rhythm they will allow. He walks through the negotiation carrying a grin and a scandal.

Decisive here means scale: rock stops being a regional noise and becomes a worldwide occupation of youth attention.
body.zh:
在 Elvis 之前，大众舞台还在商量能允许多少身体、多少黑人根源节奏。他笑着带着丑闻走进谈判桌。

这里的决定性是规模：摇滚不再是地方噪音，而是全球青年注意力的占领。

title.en: That's All Right: the factory boots up

body.en:
Memphis, Sun Records, 1954. A country-blues hybrid that should not sit so easily in one take—yet it does, and the room hears a future.

The star industry's power switch flips here: not a corporation plan, a tape that refuses to stay local.
body.zh:
孟菲斯，Sun Records，1954。本不该这么轻易坐进一条 take 的乡村-蓝调混合物——它坐下了，房间听见未来。

明星工业的电源在此按下：不是公司企划，是一盘拒绝待在本地的磁带。

title.en: Hound Dog: TV learns to panic

body.en:
The Ed Sullivan edits, the camera that cuts away from the hips, the parents who hear danger in a smile—Hound Dog turns performance into national argument.

Rock discovers scandal as distribution. The body becomes part of the broadcast.
body.zh:
Ed Sullivan 的剪辑、躲开胯部的镜头、在微笑里听见危险的家长——Hound Dog 把表演变成全国辩论。

摇滚发现丑闻也是发行渠道。身体成了广播的一部分。

title.en: Every later idol walks through Memphis
title.zh: 后来的偶像都路过孟菲斯

body.en:
From British Invasion haircuts to arena charisma manuals, the Elvis template—voice, image, desire, controversy—keeps getting rented out.

He is less a genre than a career shape. The map still bends around that silhouette.
body.zh:
从 British Invasion 的发型到体育馆魅力手册，Elvis 模板——嗓音、形象、欲望、争议——不断被租用。

他与其说是流派，不如说是一种生涯外形。地图仍绕着那道剪影弯曲。

title.en: The grin that argued with a nation

body.en:
Quotes around Elvis swing between worship and moral panic. That split is the story: mass culture learning it cannot look away.

Nail both tones to the wall. The contradiction is the voltage.
body.zh:
关于 Elvis 的引语在崇拜与道德恐慌之间摆。分裂本身就是故事：大众文化发现自己没法把视线挪开。

两种语气都钉上墙。矛盾就是电压。

note.en: Sun Studios flashpoint: country + R&B collide on radio.
note.zh: Sun 录音室引爆点：Country 与 R&B 在电台碰撞。

note.en: Not the inventor of the sound—but the mass-media ignition.
note.zh: 未必发明音色，却点燃了大众媒介。
